name: Nyan Cat Pill
author: MrSteelballs
description: Replaces the gesture pill with an animated Nyan Cat. Also rounds the quick settings panel and uses 4 tile columns.

_knobs.title: Active tile rounding
_knobs.description: Corner radius of a tile that is on.

_knobs.title: Inactive tile rounding
_knobs.description: Corner radius of a tile that is off.

_knobs.title: Active icon rounding
_knobs.description: Corner radius of the icon background of a tile that is on.

_knobs.title: Inactive icon rounding
_knobs.description: Corner radius of the icon background of a tile that is off.

_knobs.title: Panel rounding
_knobs.description: Rounding of the quick settings panel and the footer.

_knobs.title: Brightness slider shape
_knobs.description: -1 is the shape chosen in the settings, 1 circle, 2 rounded square, 3 square.

_knobs.title: Footer buttons
_knobs.description: Shape of the settings and power buttons: 0 circle, 1 square, 2 rounded.

_knobs.title: Blur
_knobs.description: False turns off the blur behind the shade, the lock screen and the other SystemUI windows; the shade becomes an opaque surface.

_knobs.title: Shade colour, top layer
_knobs.description: With no blur the shade is a mix of two colours, this is the first.

_knobs.title: Shade colour, bottom layer
_knobs.description: The second colour of the shade without blur.

_knobs.title: Shade colour, dialogs
_knobs.description: The colour of the volume dialog background and similar surfaces.

_knobs.title: Notification area colour
_knobs.description: Base colour behind the notifications.

_knobs.title: Dimmed background
_knobs.description: Colour of the scrim behind the shade.

_knobs.title: Notification rounding
_knobs.description: Corner radius of a notification.

_knobs.title: Notification rounding, inner
_knobs.description: Corner radius of notifications that touch another one.

_knobs.title: Notification area rounding
_knobs.description: Corner radius of the area behind the notifications.

_knobs.title: Notification card colour
_knobs.description: Background of every notification card and of the heads-up pop-up. Cards that an app colours (a call, a music player) keep the colour of the app. Leave it out to keep the theme colour (Material You). Give it some alpha to see the shade through the cards.

_knobs.title: Notification card picture
_knobs.description: A picture over the background of every notification card and of the heads-up pop-up, cut to the corners of the card. Cards that an app colours do not get it. PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB; an animated GIF or WebP moves while it is shown. It covers the card (centred, cropped), so give it some alpha to let the colour through, the text stays on top of it.

_knobs.title: Back arrow colour
_knobs.description: Colour of the arrow that follows your finger when you swipe back from the edge. Leave it out to keep the theme colour (Material You).

_knobs.title: Back arrow background colour
_knobs.description: Colour of the round shape behind the back arrow. Leave it out to keep the theme colour (Material You).

_knobs.title: Back arrow style
_knobs.description: 0 is the stock arrow drawn with a line, 1 a filled arrow, 2 your own shape from the arrow shape.

_knobs.title: Back arrow shape
_knobs.description: The shape of the arrow for style 2, as SVG path data in a box where x runs from 0 (the tip) towards the screen edge, and y from -1 to 1 (up and down). The stock chevron is 'M 1,-1 L 0,0 L 1,1'; add a tail with 'M 0,0 L 2,0'. It is drawn as a line and scaled to the size of the arrow, and the same shape is mirrored for the other edge.

_knobs.title: Back arrow line thickness
_knobs.description: How thick the line of the back arrow is.

_knobs.title: Stack reach
_knobs.description: Where the cards behind the middle one pile up, in card steps.

_knobs.title: Stack flat part
_knobs.description: A card follows the finger one to one up to here, in card steps.

_knobs.title: Stack shrink
_knobs.description: Scale a card loses per card step away from the middle.

_knobs.title: Smallest card
_knobs.description: The smallest scale of a card in the stack.

_knobs.title: Stack lift
_knobs.description: How far the middle card lifts over the others, in dp.

_knobs.title: Carousel turn
_knobs.description: Degrees a card turns about the vertical axis per card step away from the middle (0 keeps it flat).

_knobs.title: Fan tilt
_knobs.description: Degrees a card tilts per card step away from the middle.

_knobs.title: Card sink
_knobs.description: How far a card sinks per card step, in dp.

_knobs.title: Card fade
_knobs.description: Opacity a card loses per card step (0 keeps all opaque).

_knobs.title: Faintest card
_knobs.description: The least opacity a faded card keeps.

_knobs.title: Card order
_knobs.description: 0: the middle card is on top, 1: cards further right are over the ones to their left.

_knobs.title: Length
_knobs.description: How long the gesture pill is, as a multiple of what the navigation settings chose (2 is twice as long, 0.5 half).

_knobs.title: Thickness
_knobs.description: How thick the gesture pill is, as a multiple of the setting (it cannot be thicker than its window, about 25dp).

_knobs.title: Movement
_knobs.description: How far the pill moves with the finger when you touch the bottom edge: 0 keeps it still, 1 is the default, 2 moves it twice as far (up and down it stops at 9dp, the size of its window).

_knobs.title: Spring stiffness
_knobs.description: How hard the spring is that brings the pill back after you let go. Higher snaps back faster.

_knobs.title: Wobble
_knobs.description: How much the pill wobbles on its way back: 1 settles without a wobble, 0.62 is the default, 0.2 wobbles a lot.

_knobs.title: Pill picture
_knobs.description: A picture in place of the pill, drawn in the size of the pill and cut to its rounded shape (see Keep the pill shape). PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB; an animated GIF or WebP moves. The colour of the pill is not drawn behind it.

_knobs.title: Keep the pill shape
_knobs.description: True cuts the picture to the rounded pill, false lets the picture keep its own shape inside the pill area.

_knobs.title: Pill colour on dark
_knobs.description: The colour of the pill when what is behind it is dark.

_knobs.title: Pill colour on light
_knobs.description: The colour of the pill when what is behind it is light.

_knobs.title: App opening speed
_knobs.description: How long an app takes to open from the launcher (and from Recents), as a multiple of the stock length: 1 is stock, 0.6 is faster, 1.5 is slower. The curves keep their shape, only the length changes. For every animation of the whole system use the animation scale options of a module's settings (global/window_animation_scale, transition_animation_scale, animator_duration_scale).

_knobs.title: Airplane mode icon
_knobs.description: Shown while airplane mode is on. A white PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 17dp high and tinted by the status bar. A GIF or animated WebP moves: it is tinted like any icon (a moving silhouette) and the status bar fits it to the row.

_knobs.title: Panel width
_knobs.description: Width of the volume panel's background.

_knobs.title: Panel rounding
_knobs.description: Corner radius of the volume panel.

_knobs.title: Slider length
_knobs.description: The longest the volume slider gets (it is shorter on a small screen).

_knobs.title: Gap between parts
_knobs.description: Space between the ringer button, the slider and the buttons below it.

_knobs.title: Side margin
_knobs.description: How far the volume panel sits from the edge of the screen.

_knobs.title: Blur behind the panel
_knobs.description: Blur radius behind the volume panel.

_knobs.title: Panel colour
_knobs.description: Colour of the volume panel, the ringer drawer and the floating sliders. Leave it out to keep the theme colour (Material You).

_knobs.title: Page colour
_knobs.description: Colour behind the pages of Settings (the KamiOS look). Leave it out to keep the Material You colour.

_knobs.title: Page image
_knobs.description: An image behind the pages of Settings (KamiOS look), stretched to the screen; it replaces the page colour. PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px, a night version can be given. An animated GIF or WebP plays while the page is in front. With some alpha in it the page can be see-through, see the next knobs.

_knobs.title: Main screen tile colour
_knobs.description: Colour of the tiles on the main screen of Settings (the KamiOS look). Leave it out to keep the Material You colour.

_knobs.title: Main screen card colour
_knobs.description: Colour of the card at the top of the main screen of Settings (the KamiOS look). Leave it out to keep the Material You colour.

_knobs.title: Main screen card picture
_knobs.description: A picture over the card at the top of the main screen of Settings, cut to the card (centred, cropped). PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px; an animated GIF or WebP plays while the screen is shown. With some alpha in it the card colour shows through.

_knobs.title: Brightness bar, filled part
_knobs.description: Colour of the filled part of the brightness bar and its thumb. Leave it out to keep the theme colour. A gradient (KamiOS > Quick settings gradient settings) replaces it while it is on.

_knobs.title: Brightness bar, empty part
_knobs.description: Colour of the empty part of the brightness bar. Leave it out to keep the theme colour.

_knobs.title: Volume slider, filled part
_knobs.description: Colour of the filled part of the volume sliders (the panel and the volume slider in quick settings) and their thumb. Leave it out to keep the theme colour. A gradient replaces it while it is on.

_knobs.title: Volume slider, empty part
_knobs.description: Colour of the empty part of the volume sliders. Leave it out to keep the theme colour.

_knobs.title: Slider rounding
_knobs.description: Corner radius of the volume slider in the panel, in dp. -1 keeps the stock 12.

_knobs.title: Slider thickness
_knobs.description: How thick the volume slider in the panel is, in dp. -1 keeps the stock 40.

_knobs.title: Mixer media icon
_knobs.description: The media icon on the full volume mixer page (the slider opened from the panel's mixer button). A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

_knobs.title: Ring slider vibrate icon
_knobs.description: The ring volume slider while the ringer is on vibrate. A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

_knobs.title: Media volume icon
_knobs.description: The icon of the media slider in the volume panel (level high). A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

_knobs.title: Media volume low icon
_knobs.description: Media volume, level low. A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

_knobs.title: Media muted icon

_knobs.title: Ring volume icon

_knobs.title: Alarm muted icon
_knobs.description: The alarm volume muted. A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

_knobs.title: Alarm volume icon

_knobs.title: Mixer button icon

_knobs.title: Captions icon

_knobs.title: Vibrate button icon
_knobs.description: The ringer button of the volume panel while the ringer is on vibrate (and the vibrate choice in its drawer). A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

_knobs.title: Page see-through
_knobs.description: True makes the Settings windows see-through: what is below shows where the page colour or image has alpha. Needs a colour or image with some transparency.

_knobs.title: Page shows the wallpaper
_knobs.description: True shows the wallpaper behind the Settings windows where the page colour or image has alpha (also see-through).

_knobs.title: Blur behind the page
_knobs.description: Blurs what is behind a see-through Settings window, like frosted glass. 0dp is off, 20dp to 40dp looks good.

_knobs.title: Tile rounding
_knobs.description: The rounding of the tiles of the main screen of Settings (the KamiOS look). 0dp makes them square.

_knobs.title: Top card rounding
_knobs.description: The rounding of the card at the top of the main screen of Settings.

_knobs.title: Symbol round rounding
_knobs.description: The rounding of the round behind the symbol in the card at the top: 24dp is a circle, 0dp a square.

_knobs.title: Tile gap
_knobs.description: Half the space between two tiles of the main screen of Settings.

_knobs.title: Tile height
_knobs.description: The least height of a square tile of the main screen of Settings.

_knobs.title: Tiles per row
_knobs.description: How many tiles are in a row on the main screen of Settings (the KamiOS look): 1 makes a list of wide tiles, 2 is the default, 3 a dense grid.

_knobs.title: Tile that is on, picture
_knobs.description: A picture behind the icon and text of every quick settings tile that is on, over its colour. PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB; an animated GIF or WebP moves while it is shown. It covers the area (centred, cropped), so give it some alpha to let the colour through.

_knobs.title: Tiles with a picture of their own
_knobs.description: Which tile uses which of the eight picture slots below, like 'internet:1,bt:2,flashlight:3': the name of the tile, a colon and the slot number. Names: internet, bt, cell, airplane, flashlight, nfc, cast, hotspot, location, rotation, dnd, battery, saver, inversion, night and the other tiles of the list (custom tiles of apps are 'custom(package/Class)'). A tile that is not named, or whose slot has no picture, keeps the picture of all tiles.

_knobs.title: Tile that is on, picture 1
_knobs.description: The picture of the tiles that the map gives slot 1, while they are on. Same as the picture of all tiles that are on: PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB, an animated GIF or WebP moves.

_knobs.title: Shade picture
_knobs.description: A picture over the dim layer behind the whole shade (quick settings and notifications). It fades in and out with the shade like the dim layer does, so it is as strong as the dim layer is. PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB; an animated GIF or WebP moves while it is shown. It covers the area (centred, cropped), so give it some alpha to let the colour through.

_knobs.title: Panel picture
_knobs.description: A picture over the background of the volume panel, cut to its rounded corners. PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB; an animated GIF or WebP moves while it is shown. It covers the area (centred, cropped), so give it some alpha to let the colour through.

_knobs.title: Brightness bar fill picture
_knobs.description: A picture in the filled part of the brightness bar, instead of its colour. PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB; an animated GIF or WebP moves. It covers the slider (centred, cropped) and stays where it is: the fill uncovers it as the value grows.

_knobs.title: Volume slider fill picture
_knobs.description: A picture in the filled part of the volume sliders (the panel and the quick settings volume slider), instead of their colour. PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB; an animated GIF or WebP moves. It covers the slider (centred, cropped) and stays where it is: the fill uncovers it as the value grows.

_knobs.title: Battery frame
_knobs.description: The outline of the battery icon, always drawn. Setting a frame or a fill replaces the stock battery everywhere (status bar, lock screen, quick settings). A white picture with transparency: the status bar tints it like every icon. A GIF or animated WebP moves. It is drawn as large as fits the battery box, the shape kept.

_knobs.title: Battery fill
_knobs.description: The inside of the battery: shown from the empty side up to the charge level, over the frame. A white picture with transparency: the status bar tints it like every icon. A GIF or animated WebP moves. It is drawn as large as fits the battery box, the shape kept.

_knobs.title: Charging picture
_knobs.description: A picture over the battery while the phone charges (a bolt, for example). A white picture with transparency: the status bar tints it like every icon. A GIF or animated WebP moves. It is drawn as large as fits the battery box, the shape kept.

_knobs.title: Battery fill direction
_knobs.description: 0 fills from the left, 1 fills upwards (for a standing battery).
